title: EU AI Act Article 5 — Prohibited AI practices
description: The list of AI practices considered unacceptable risk and banned outright under the EU AI Act. Referenced here as a general framework anchor for manipulative-technique concerns (e.g. deceptive synthetic media) rather than as the enforcing law in the specific US robocall case it is linked to. Paraphrase pending verification against the primary EUR-Lex text — hence 'Community' confidence.
control_text: Bans specific AI practices considered unacceptable risk, including subliminal, manipulative, or deceptive techniques that materially distort a person's behaviour and cause harm, exploitation of vulnerabilities, social scoring of individuals, and (with narrow exceptions) real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces by law enforcement.

citations.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
